senses.title: Before an adjective or adverb
senses.definition: used to concede a quality that limits the main statement
senses.definitionCN: 承认一种限定主句的性质
senses.example: The room was small, albeit comfortable.
senses.exampleCN: 房间小，尽管很舒适。
senses.why: Albeit is all be it, a compressed although it be, and the compression is why it usually takes a bare adjective rather than a full clause.
senses.whyCN: albeit 由「全是」「是」「它」三个词压缩而来，相当于把「尽管它是」缩短成一个词，正因压缩，它通常接一个光形容词而不是完整从句。

senses.title: Before a noun or prepositional phrase
senses.definition: used to concede a circumstance stated as a phrase
senses.definitionCN: 承认以短语形式陈述的某种情形
senses.example: He agreed, albeit with reluctance.
senses.exampleCN: 他同意了，尽管很不情愿。
senses.why: Because the verb is already folded away, the word can attach to any short phrase that names the limiting circumstance.
senses.whyCN: 因为动词已经被折起来，这个词可以挂在任何点明限定情形的短短语上。

senses.title: Before a full clause, rarely
senses.definition: used with a whole clause in older or very formal prose
senses.definitionCN: 在较古或极正式的文字中接一整个从句
senses.example: Albeit the evidence is thin, the claim is plausible.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管证据薄弱，这一主张仍说得通。
senses.why: The full-clause use keeps the original it be structure alive, which is exactly why it now sounds archaic.
senses.whyCN: 接完整从句的用法保留了原先的残余动词，也正因如此，它现在听起来古旧。

senses.title: Even in the rare case
senses.definition: used to grant a fact that occurs seldom but must still be admitted
senses.definitionCN: 承认一件很少发生却仍须承认的事实
senses.example: Albeit rarely, the system does fail.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管很少见，这个系统确实会失灵。
senses.why: When the conceded fact is rare, the concession leans toward even if, because the exception still has to be counted.
senses.whyCN: 当被承认的事实很罕见时，让步就偏向「即使」，因为这个例外仍须被计入。

senses.title: The mild trailing but
senses.definition: used at the end of a clause to add a small qualification after the fact
senses.definitionCN: 放在从句末尾，事后补上一点限定
senses.example: The plan works, albeit slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 这个方案行得通，尽管慢。
senses.why: Placed after the main point, the word behaves like a softened but and lets the reader keep the good news in front.
senses.whyCN: 放在要点之后，这个词就像一个被放软的转折词，让读者把好消息留在前面。

senses.title: Granting a partial truth
senses.definition: used when something holds only in part
senses.definitionCN: 指某说法只在部分意义上成立
senses.example: The theory is sound, albeit incomplete.
senses.exampleCN: 这个理论站得住，尽管并不完整。
senses.why: Conceding incompleteness without withdrawing the claim is precisely the balancing act the word performs.
senses.whyCN: 承认不完整却不撤回主张，正是这个词所做的平衡动作。

senses.title: The inserted concession
senses.definition: used between commas to qualify a noun phrase already under way
senses.definitionCN: 夹在两个逗号之间，限定正在展开的名词短语
senses.example: The data, albeit limited, support the claim.
senses.exampleCN: 这些数据尽管有限，却支持这一主张。
senses.why: The compressed form fits inside a noun phrase, where a full clause could not stand without breaking the sentence.
senses.whyCN: 这个压缩形式能塞进名词短语内部，而完整从句若要站在那里就会把句子拆散。

senses.title: The register: formal and literary
senses.definition: used where a formal or literary tone is wanted instead of although or though
senses.definitionCN: 在需要正式或文学语气时替代其他让步连词
senses.example: The reforms, albeit necessary, were unpopular.
senses.exampleCN: 这些改革尽管必要，却不得人心。
senses.why: Because the word is shortened, it reads as written rather than spoken, and that distance is part of its effect.
senses.whyCN: 因为这个词是被缩短的，读起来像书面而非口语，这份距离感正是它效果的一部分。

intro.en: Albeit is a Middle English contraction of all be it, meaning although it be. It is Germanic and has no Latin cognate, so no Latin entries are listed; quamquam and licet are counterparts only.
intro.cn: albeit 是中古英语 all be it 的缩写，意为「although it be」。它属日耳曼语，没有拉丁同族词，因此不列拉丁词条；拉丁语 quamquam 与 licet 只是对应说法。

items.en: Eall means wholly or all, and in compounds it often adds emphasis rather than quantity.
items.cn: eall 意为全然、全部，在复合形式中常起加强作用而非表数量。

items.en: Beon is the verb to be, whose subjunctive forms survive in fixed phrases such as be it so.
items.cn: bēon 是动词「是」，其虚拟式形式存留于 be it so 之类的固定短语中。

items.en: All be it is recorded in the fourteenth century as a full clause meaning although it be, still written in separate words.
items.cn: all be it 于十四世纪以完整从句形式记录，意为 although it be，各词仍分开书写。

items.en: By the late fourteenth century the parts are written as one word, and the verb disappears from view.
items.cn: 到十四世纪后期，各部分写成一个词，动词便从字面上消失了。

items.en: Modern English keeps the word for formal prose, because its compressed shape cannot easily take a full clause.
items.cn: 现代英语把这个词留给正式文字，因为它的压缩形态不易容纳完整从句。

note.en: The first group shares the all be it family and ranks the three levels of formality. The second group gives plainer concessive words available in speech.
note.cn: 第一组属于 all be it 一族，并排出三档正式度。第二组给出日常口语可用的更朴素的让步词。

entries.definition: Although it be, with though in place of the verb; it takes a full clause and is neutral in register.
entries.definitionCN: 由 although it be 而来，用 though 替代动词；接完整从句，语体中性。

entries.definition: The everyday concessive word, which may also end a sentence.
entries.definitionCN: 日常让步词，也可以放在句末。

entries.definition: Concedes a fact that makes the main clause more surprising.
entries.definitionCN: 承认一件使主句更显意外的事实。

entries.definition: However; although, built as how be it and now archaic.
entries.definitionCN: 然而、虽然，由 how be it 构成，今已古旧。

entries.definition: Granting a point and moving on, using the same subjunctive be.
entries.definitionCN: 承认一点然后继续，用的是同一个虚拟式 be。

entries.definition: In spite of; heavier and more formal than albeit.
entries.definitionCN: 尽管；比 albeit 更重、更正式。

entries.definition: Used to concede or contrast, often with simultaneous time.
entries.definitionCN: 用于让步或对比，常带同时意味。

entries.definition: Concedes a hypothesis rather than a fact.
entries.definitionCN: 承认的是假设而非事实。

entries.definition: Granting that something is true before arguing further.
entries.definitionCN: 在继续论证前承认某事为真。

entries.definition: A fixed way to name the price of a conceded gain.
entries.definitionCN: 点明所得好处之代价的固定说法。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real all be it contraction and the three formal levels of albeit, although and though.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的 all be it 缩写，以及 albeit、although、though 三档正式度。

normal.en: Say all be it quickly and you hear albeit: the verb is swallowed.
normal.cn: 把 all be it 说快一点就听见 albeit：动词被吞掉了。

normal.en: Because the verb is gone, the word usually takes a bare adjective: small, albeit comfortable.
normal.cn: 因为动词没了，这个词通常接一个光形容词：小，尽管舒适。

normal.en: Albeit is the formal one, although is neutral, though is spoken and can sit at the end.
normal.cn: albeit 最正式，although 中性，though 口语且可放句末。

normal.en: Albeit briefly is a fixed pair that shows the typical shape: one short phrase after the comma.
normal.cn: 「albeit briefly」是固定搭配，显示典型形态：逗号后一个短短语。

normal.en: Howbeit is the archaic twin, built on how be it instead of all be it.
normal.cn: howbeit 是古旧的孪生形式，用 how be it 而非 all be it。

abstract.en: A door left ajar is a whole concession compressed into one narrow opening.
abstract.cn: 一扇虚掩的门，就是把整段让步压缩成一条窄缝。

abstract.en: The word admits the flaw and then quietly refuses to withdraw anything.
abstract.cn: 这个词承认缺陷，然后安静地拒绝撤回任何主张。

abstract.en: Speaking in a shorter form is itself a way of sounding more certain.
abstract.cn: 用更短的形式说话，本身就是一种显得更确定的方式。

examples.en: The scheme succeeded, albeit at considerable cost.
examples.cn: 这项计划成功了，尽管代价不小。

examples.en: She kept working, albeit with frequent pauses.
examples.cn: 她继续工作，尽管频繁停顿。

examples.en: The evidence, albeit indirect, points the same way.
examples.cn: 证据尽管是间接的，却指向同一个方向。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「奥尔比伊特」，拆成 all be it「就算是这样」：就算这样，也要承认，就是尽管

root: 中古英语 all be it（= although it be「就算是这样」）的缩合形式，十四世纪合为一词，动词 be 从字面消失，因此现代多接形容词、名词或介词短语，接完整从句则显古旧。属日耳曼语，无拉丁同族词，latinEntries 留空。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses are one act of concession in different shapes: before an adjective, before a phrase, before a rare full clause, granting a rare fact, trailing after the main point, granting partial truth, inserted between commas, and marking a formal register.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项是同一个让步动作的不同形态：接形容词、接短语、较少见地接完整从句、承认罕见事实、跟在要点之后、承认部分成立、夹在逗号间，以及标记正式语体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door opened just wide enough to pass through sideways.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇门只开到勉强侧身能过的宽度。

branches.en: THE ADJECTIVE SLOT: a single quality conceded after the comma.
branches.cn: 形容词格：逗号之后只让出一个性质。

branches.en: THE PHRASE SLOT: a circumstance stated as a phrase, and the same phrase inserted mid-sentence.
branches.cn: 短语格：以短语陈述的情形，以及同一短语插在句中。

branches.en: THE FULL CLAUSE: the older shape that still sounds archaic.
branches.cn: 完整从句：仍显古旧的较老形态。

branches.en: THE LIMIT: a rare fact that must be counted, and a truth that holds only in part.
branches.cn: 限度：必须计入的罕见事实，以及只部分成立的真相。

branches.en: THE SOFTENED BUT: a trailing qualification, and the formal distance of the shortened form.
branches.cn: 放软的转折：拖在句末的限定，以及缩略形式带来的正式距离。

intro.en: Albeit is not affixed but contracted: all plus the subjunctive be plus it. Its relatives are whole words rather than suffixes, so the items below list components and parallel forms.
intro.cn: albeit 不是加缀而是缩合：all 加虚拟式 be 加 it。它的亲属是整词而非后缀，因此下面列出构词成分与平行形式。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic and has no Latin cognate, so no Latin entries are listed; quamquam and licet are only semantic counterparts.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词属日耳曼语，没有拉丁同族词，因此不列拉丁词条；quamquam 与 licet 仅在语义上对应。

items.example: The first part adds emphasis to the concession.
items.exampleCN: 第一部分给让步加上强调。

items.example: The subjunctive survives only in fixed formulas.
items.exampleCN: 虚拟式只存留于固定套语中。

items.example: The pronoun carried the whole clause that is now compressed.
items.exampleCN: 这个代词承载了如今被压缩掉的整个从句。

items.structure: English contraction of all be it
items.example: The contraction is the reason a full clause sounds archaic after it.
items.exampleCN: 正因它是缩合形式，接完整从句才显得古旧。

items.meaning: in spite of the fact that
items.example: The fuller cousin keeps a clause-friendly shape.
items.exampleCN: 这位更完整的表亲保留了可接从句的形态。

items.example: It is the spoken partner and may close a sentence.
items.exampleCN: 它是口语搭档，也可以收束一个句子。

items.structure: English contraction, how plus be plus it
items.example: The archaic twin uses the same compressed verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个古旧孪生形式用的是同一个被压缩的动词。

items.example: The same subjunctive be survives here in plain sight.
items.exampleCN: 同一个虚拟式 be 在这里明明白白地活着。

items.example: It concedes a hypothesis where albeit concedes a fact.
items.exampleCN: 它承认的是假设，而 albeit 承认的是事实。

items.example: The heavier formal alternative stands later in the register scale.
items.exampleCN: 这个更重的正式替代说法在语体阶梯上更靠后。

definition_en: in spite of the fact that; used to introduce a clause that limits the main statement
core_image: 拉车的马已经累了，车却还在往前走
scene: 山道很窄，一侧就是深谷，队伍还是按原计划走完了全程。Although the path was narrow, the group finished the route as planned.
sceneCN: 这里指承认山道狭窄而主句情况仍成立（第 1 个义项：引导让步从句）；句意为尽管路窄，队伍仍按计划走完了全程。

pos.zh: 虽然；尽管（引导让步状语从句；口语中也可单独置于句首表转折）

derivatives.zh: 虽然；不过（核心成分，可置句末）
全然（构词成分，起加强作用）
好像（though 的另一支，表虚拟比较）
尽管（同义但多接短语的缩合形式）

senses.title: The standard concessive clause
senses.definition: used to introduce a fact that makes the main clause less expected
senses.definitionCN: 引出使主句显得不那么顺理成章的事实
senses.example: Although the road was icy, we drove slowly and arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管道路结冰，我们还是缓慢行驶并到达了。
senses.why: All plus though makes a strengthened though, and the full clause shape is why this is the neutral everyday concessive.
senses.whyCN: all 加 though 构成加强的 though，而完整从句的形态正是它成为中性日常让步词的原因。

senses.title: Conceding a possibility
senses.definition: used with may or might to grant a possibility before answering it
senses.definitionCN: 与情态动词连用，先承认一种可能再作答
senses.example: Although it may rain, the match will go on.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管可能会下雨，比赛仍将进行。
senses.why: With a modal the concession becomes hypothetical, which moves the word toward even if without reaching it.
senses.whyCN: 带上情态动词，让步就变成假设性的，这使这个词向「即使」靠近，却并未到达。

senses.title: The spoken however
senses.definition: used alone at the start of a sentence in speech to mean however
senses.definitionCN: 口语中单独放在句首表「不过」
senses.example: Although, I could be wrong about the date.
senses.exampleCN: 不过，日期上我可能记错了。
senses.why: In speech the clause is left unfinished, so the word alone carries a self-correction rather than a full concession.
senses.whyCN: 口语里从句没有说完，于是这个词独自承担一次自我修正，而不是完整让步。

senses.title: The clause after the main point
senses.definition: used after the main clause to add a qualification at the end
senses.definitionCN: 放在主句之后，在句末补上限定
senses.example: It is a good idea, although the timing is bad.
senses.exampleCN: 这是个好主意，不过时机不好。
senses.why: Position changes the emphasis: the concession arrives last, so the good news keeps first place.
senses.whyCN: 位置改变强调：让步最后才到，好消息因而保住第一位。

senses.title: The reduced concessive
senses.definition: used with a participle or adjective when the subject is understood
senses.definitionCN: 主语一致时后接分词或形容词的省略式
senses.example: Although tired, she finished the race.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管很累，她还是跑完了比赛。
senses.why: When the subject is shared, English drops it, and the conjunction attaches directly to the adjective.
senses.whyCN: 主语一致时英语把它省掉，连词便直接挂在形容词上。

senses.title: Conceding the limits of a study
senses.definition: used in academic writing to admit a weakness and keep the claim
senses.definitionCN: 学术写作中承认弱点而保留主张
senses.example: Although limited, the study is influential.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究尽管有局限，却很有影响。
senses.why: Scholars concede before they defend, and this conjunction is the standard opening for that move.
senses.whyCN: 学者先让步再辩护，而这个连词正是那个动作的标准开场。

senses.title: Conceding a counter-example
senses.definition: used to acknowledge exceptions before stating the general trend
senses.definitionCN: 在陈述总体趋势前先承认例外
senses.example: Although some trials failed, the overall trend is clear.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管有些试验失败，总体趋势仍然清楚。
senses.why: The word lets an exception into the sentence without letting it overturn the conclusion.
senses.whyCN: 这个词让例外进入句子，却不许它推翻结论。

senses.title: Conceding while insisting
senses.definition: used with it is true that to grant a fact and then balance it
senses.definitionCN: 与「诚然」式结构连用，承认事实后再作平衡
senses.example: Although it is true that costs rose, output also grew.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管成本确实上升，产出也增长了。
senses.why: The formula makes the concession explicit and measurable, so the second clause can be weighed against it.
senses.whyCN: 这个框架把让步说得明确、可衡量，于是第二句可以与它放在天平上。

intro.en: Although is all plus though, with all adding emphasis. Though goes back to Old English theah, reinforced by Old Norse tho. The word is Germanic with no Latin cognate, so no Latin entries are listed.
intro.cn: although 是 all 加 though，all 起加强作用。though 追溯至古英语 theah，并受古诺尔斯语 tho 强化。这个词属日耳曼语，没有拉丁同族词，因此不列拉丁词条。

items.en: Theah means though or however, and it already allowed both a concessive and an adversative reading.
items.cn: theah 意为「虽然、然而」，本身已同时容许让步与转折两种读法。

items.en: Norse tho, brought in during the Scandinavian settlements, strengthens the same word in northern English.
items.cn: 斯堪的纳维亚定居时期带入的诺尔斯语 tho 在英格兰北部强化了同一个词。

items.en: The compound all though appears in the fourteenth century, with all acting as an intensifier rather than meaning everything.
items.cn: 复合形式 all though 于十四世纪出现，其中的 all 起加强作用，并不表示「全部」。

items.en: Printing fixes the single-word spelling although, while though remains free to stand at the end of a clause.
items.cn: 印刷把拼写固定为单词 although，而 though 仍可自由地放在从句末尾。

items.en: Modern English treats although as the neutral written form and though as its spoken and trailing partner.
items.cn: 现代英语把 although 视为中性的书面形式，把 though 视为它的口语与句末搭档。

note.en: The first group shares the though family, including as though, which is not concessive at all. The second group gives alternatives with different weights.
note.cn: 第一组属于 though 一族，其中 as though 根本不是让步。第二组给出分量不同的替代说法。

entries.definition: The shorter word inside although; it can also end a sentence as a trailing however.
entries.definitionCN: although 内部的短词；也可放句末作「不过」。

entries.definition: Concedes a fact that makes the main clause more surprising than although alone.
entries.definitionCN: 承认一件使主句比单用 although 更显意外的事实。

entries.definition: As if, expressing a comparison or an unreal situation, not a concession.
entries.definitionCN: 好像，表比较或非真实情形，并非让步。

entries.definition: Although, but usually followed by a phrase rather than a clause.
entries.definitionCN: 尽管，但通常接短语而非从句。

entries.definition: An informal spelling of though, used in casual writing.
entries.definitionCN: though 的非正式拼写，用于随意写作。

entries.definition: Concedes or contrasts, often with a hint of simultaneous time.
entries.definitionCN: 让步或对比，常带同时意味。

entries.definition: The formal British variant of while.
entries.definitionCN: while 的英式正式变体。

entries.definition: In spite of, with a much more formal and emphatic tone.
entries.definitionCN: 尽管，语气正式且更强调。

entries.definition: Concedes a possibility rather than an established fact.
entries.definitionCN: 承认的是可能性而非既定事实。

entries.definition: The same concession built into a preposition taking a noun.
entries.definitionCN: 同一让步装进介词，后接名词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real theah origin, the all intensifier and the split between although, though and as though.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的 theah 来源、起加强作用的 all，以及 although、though、as though 三者的分工。

normal.en: All plus though simply means thoroughly though, which is why it feels stronger than though alone.
normal.cn: all 加 though 就是「彻头彻尾地虽然」，所以比单用 though 更有力。

normal.en: Although takes a full clause; though may trail at the end of the sentence.
normal.cn: although 接完整从句；though 可以拖在句子末尾。

normal.en: As though means as if, and it compares instead of conceding.
normal.cn: as though 意为「好像」，它做的是比较，不是让步。

normal.en: Although tired drops the shared subject and keeps the adjective.
normal.cn: although tired 省掉相同的主语，只留下形容词。

normal.en: Although it is true that is a measuring frame: admit one fact, then weigh the other.
normal.cn: although it is true that 是一个称量框架：承认一件事，再称另一件。

abstract.en: A horse still pulling a cart says the load is heavy without saying it is impossible.
abstract.cn: 还在拉车的马，说明车重，却没说车拉不动。

abstract.en: Concession is the courtesy that keeps an argument from breaking.
abstract.cn: 让步是让争论不至于断裂的那种礼貌。

abstract.en: The conceded fact is kept in the sentence like a stone in the pocket, always felt.
abstract.cn: 被承认的事实留在句子里，像口袋里的石头，一直被摸到。

examples.en: Although the sample was small, the effect was consistent.
examples.cn: 尽管样本小，效应却是一致的。

examples.en: She agreed to the change, although she doubted it would help.
examples.cn: 她同意这项改动，尽管她怀疑它未必有用。

examples.en: Although still unfinished, the building already draws visitors.
examples.cn: 尽管尚未完工，这座建筑已经吸引了访客。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「奥尔奏」，all 加 though：把「虽然」说满，就是尽管

root: 英语复合词 all + though；though 来自古英语 theah「虽然、然而」，并受古诺尔斯语 tho 强化，all 起加强作用。十四世纪合为一词，印刷时代固定拼写。属日耳曼语，无拉丁同族词，latinEntries 留空。though 另有句末「不过」用法，as though 则表「好像」，不作让步。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses are one concession placed in eight positions: the standard clause, a modal possibility, a spoken unfinished however, a trailing clause, a reduced clause, a study's admitted limits, an acknowledged exception, and the it is true that frame.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项是同一个让步放在八种位置：标准从句、情态可能、口语中未说完的「不过」、拖在句末的从句、省略式、研究的自承局限、被承认的反例，以及 it is true that 框架。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tired horse still pulling the cart forward.
core.cn: 核心意象：一匹已经疲倦的马，仍在把车往前拉。

branches.en: THE STANDARD CLAUSE: a fact set against the main statement.
branches.cn: 标准从句：与主句相抗的一件事实。

branches.en: THE POSSIBILITY: conceded with a modal, close to even if.
branches.cn: 可能性：带情态动词的让步，接近 even if。

branches.en: THE POSITION: the unfinished spoken however, and the qualification placed after the main point.
branches.cn: 位置：口语中未说完的「不过」，以及放在要点之后的限定。

branches.en: THE REDUCED FORM: shared subject dropped, adjective left standing.
branches.cn: 省略形式：相同主语省去，只留形容词。

branches.en: THE MEASURED CONCESSION: admitting limits, allowing exceptions, and weighing with it is true that.
branches.cn: 有度量的让步：承认局限、容许例外，以及用 it is true that 来称量。

intro.en: Although is a compound of all and though, not a suffixed form. The base though survives alone and also builds even though and as though, the last of which means as if.
intro.cn: although 是 all 与 though 的复合词，不是加后缀的形式。基词 though 单独存活，也构成 even though 与 as though，后者意为「好像」。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic and has no Latin cognate, so no Latin entries are listed; quamquam and etsi are counterparts only.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词属日耳曼语，没有拉丁同族词，因此不列拉丁词条；quamquam 与 etsi 只是对应说法。

items.example: It adds force without adding a separate meaning.
items.exampleCN: 它只加力，不添加独立意义。

items.structure: Old English theah, conj. and adv.
items.example: The base word can stand alone, even at the end of a sentence.
items.exampleCN: 基词可以单独站住，甚至可以放在句末。

items.meaning: in spite of the fact that
items.example: The compound is the neutral written concessive.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词是中性的书面让步词。

items.example: Even makes the conceded fact harder to dismiss.
items.exampleCN: even 使被承认的事实更难被忽略。

items.example: This branch compares and does not concede.
items.exampleCN: 这一支做比较，不做让步。

items.example: Casual writing drops the final letters.
items.exampleCN: 随意写作把末尾几个字母丢掉。

items.example: The compressed rival usually takes a phrase.
items.exampleCN: 这位被压缩的对手通常接短语。

items.example: The heavier word signals a more formal register.
items.exampleCN: 更重的那个词表示更正式的语体。

items.structure: Old English hwīl used as conjunction
items.example: Time and contrast are mixed in this rival.
items.exampleCN: 这个对手把时间与对比混在一起。

items.example: It compresses the concession into a phrase opener.
items.exampleCN: 它把让步压缩成一个短语开头。

definition_en: in spite of; used as a preposition, a conjunction or a trailing adverb to say that something does not prevent the rest
core_image: 堤坝被水漫过一半，却仍然立在那里挡住洪水
scene: 连日暴雨，桥基泡在水里，工程队还是按时完成了加固。Notwithstanding the heavy rain, the crew finished the reinforcement on schedule.
sceneCN: 这里指暴雨并未阻止施工（第 1 个义项：介词用法，后接名词表让步）；句意为尽管连日暴雨，工程队仍按时完成了加固。

pos.zh: 尽管（后接名词或名词短语）
尽管如此（放句末或独立使用）

collocations.zh: 尽管有任何相反约定（法律）

forms.label: 介词/连词/副词（无屈折变化）

derivatives.zh: 经受住；抵挡（本词的构词核心）
withstand 的过去式与过去分词
withstand 的现在分词（本词的第二成分）
尽管（后接从句的固定形式）
排除性条款（法律中可排除其他规定的条款）

senses.title: The preposition before a noun
senses.definition: used before a noun phrase to say that it does not block what follows
senses.definitionCN: 放在名词短语前，表示它并不能阻挡后文所述
senses.example: Notwithstanding the rain, the match continued.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管下雨，比赛仍继续进行。
senses.why: The word began as a participle phrase meaning not withstanding, that is, not resisting, and it still carries that image of something standing up against pressure.
senses.whyCN: 这个词起初是分词短语，意为「不抵挡」，即不因压力而退让，至今仍带着「顶住压力站着」的意象。

senses.title: The conjunction with that
senses.titleCN: 连词用法：后接完整从句
senses.definition: used with that to introduce a full clause of concession
senses.definitionCN: 后接连接词，引出完整的让步从句
senses.example: Notwithstanding that the evidence was thin, the case proceeded.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管证据薄弱，案件仍继续审理。
senses.why: Adding that turns the participle into a clause opener, which is the most formal way to concede a whole statement.
senses.whyCN: 后接连接词就把分词变成从句引导词，这是承认整句陈述最正式的方式。

senses.title: The trailing adverb
senses.definition: placed at the end of a clause to mean all the same
senses.definitionCN: 放在从句末尾，表示「仍然如此」
senses.example: The weather was bad; the match went on notwithstanding.
senses.exampleCN: 天气很糟，比赛还是照常进行。
senses.why: At the end of a clause the participle stands alone and repeats the concession already made by the facts.
senses.whyCN: 放在从句末尾时，这个分词独自站住，把事实已经作出的让步再说一遍。

senses.title: The postposition after a noun
senses.definition: placed after a noun instead of before it, a formal stylistic option
senses.definitionCN: 放在名词之后而非之前，是正式文体的一种选择
senses.example: The delays notwithstanding, the bridge opened on time.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管有延误，这座桥仍按时通车。
senses.why: Because the word is historically a participle, it can follow its noun, as absolute constructions often do.
senses.whyCN: 因为这个词历史上是分词，所以它能跟在名词之后，正如绝对结构常做的那样。

senses.title: The legal override clause
senses.definition: used in statutes and contracts to give a provision priority over others
senses.definitionCN: 在法条与合同中使某条款优先于其他规定
senses.example: Notwithstanding any other provision, this clause prevails.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管有任何其他规定，本条仍然优先适用。
senses.why: Legally the word does not merely concede a fact; it cancels a competing rule, which is the strongest use of the image.
senses.whyCN: 在法律上，这个词不只是承认一个事实，而是取消一条竞争性规则，这是该意象最强的用法。

senses.title: Not held back by a circumstance
senses.definition: used of a person or thing that is not limited by a stated factor
senses.definitionCN: 指人或事物不为所述因素所限
senses.example: Notwithstanding his age, he works full days.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管年事已高，他仍整日工作。
senses.why: The original sense of withstanding survives here: the factor presses, and the subject simply does not give way.
senses.whyCN: withstand 的原义在此存活：那个因素在施压，而主体就是不退让。

senses.title: Priority over an earlier agreement
senses.definition: used in contracts so that a term applies even where an earlier term says otherwise
senses.definitionCN: 用于合同，使某一条款即使在先条款另有规定时仍适用
senses.example: The clause applies notwithstanding the earlier agreement.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管有在先协议，本条款仍然适用。
senses.why: Hierarchy among clauses needs an explicit marker, and this is the marker that says the newer rule stands.
senses.whyCN: 条款之间的层级需要一个明确标记，而这个词正是说明新规则站得住的标记。

senses.title: The most formal concession
senses.definition: used where the register must be maximally formal, as in statutes and treaties
senses.definitionCN: 用于语体必须最正式的场合，如法条与条约
senses.example: Notwithstanding repeated warnings, the practice continued.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管一再警告，这种做法仍然继续。
senses.why: Because the word is long and archaic in shape, it suits documents that want weight rather than ease.
senses.whyCN: 因为这个词形长而古，适合那些要分量而非轻便的文件。

intro.en: Notwithstanding is not plus withstanding, the participle of withstand, from Old English withstandan, to stand against. It is Germanic with no Latin cognate, so no Latin entries are listed; the legal non obstante is a counterpart only.
intro.cn: notwithstanding 是 not 加 withstanding，后者是 withstand 的分词；withstand 出自古英语 withstandan「站着对抗」。它属日耳曼语，没有拉丁同族词，因此不列拉丁词条；法律拉丁语 non obstante 只是对应说法。

items.en: Withstandan joins with, against, and standan, to stand: to stand against something pressing.
items.cn: withstandan 由 with「对抗」与 standan「站立」合成：顶着压力站着。

items.en: The participle withstanding appears in the sense of resisting, and the negative phrase not withstanding is built on it.
items.cn: 分词 withstanding 以「抵抗」之义出现，否定短语 not withstanding 便建在它上面。

items.en: Not withstanding comes to mean in spite of and is written as one word in legal and parliamentary records.
items.cn: not withstanding 转义为「尽管」，并在法律与议会记录中写成一个词。

items.en: The notwithstanding clause becomes a named constitutional device in Canadian law in the twentieth century.
items.cn: 在加拿大法律中，notwithstanding clause 于二十世纪成为一个有专门名称的宪法机制。

items.en: Modern English keeps the word for formal and legal prose; speech prefers despite or in spite of.
items.cn: 现代英语把这个词留给正式与法律文字；口语更爱用 despite 或 in spite of。

note.en: The first group shares the withstand standing-root. The second group names concession at different weights, from the everyday to the legal.
note.cn: 第一组共享 withstand「顶住」词根。第二组按分量的轻重给出让步说法，从日常到法律。

entries.definition: To resist or endure pressure without giving way.
entries.definitionCN: 顶住压力而不退让。

entries.definition: The past and past participle of withstand.
entries.definitionCN: withstand 的过去式与过去分词。

entries.definition: The participle inside the word, meaning resisting.
entries.definitionCN: 词内的分词成分，意为抵挡。

entries.definition: The conjunction form that takes a full clause.
entries.definitionCN: 接完整从句的连词形式。

entries.definition: A provision that lets a law override other rules, named in Canadian constitutional law.
entries.definitionCN: 允许某项法律排除其他规则的条款，加拿大宪法中有专名。

entries.definition: In spite of, with a noun or gerund; shorter and less formal.
entries.definitionCN: 尽管，后接名词或动名词；更短、更不正式。

entries.definition: The everyday phrase for the same relation.
entries.definitionCN: 表达同一关系的日常短语。

entries.definition: Concedes with a full clause, neutral in register.
entries.definitionCN: 用完整从句让步，语体中性。

entries.definition: All the same; marks the main clause as unaffected by what came before.
entries.definitionCN: 仍然如此；标出主句不受前文影响。

entries.definition: Without being affected by the stated factor.
entries.definitionCN: 不受所述因素影响。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real withstand standing-root and the real legal override clause.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的 withstand「顶住」词根与真实的法律排除条款。

normal.en: Withstand is with plus stand: something stands against the pressure and does not fall.
normal.cn: withstand 是 with 加 stand：某物顶住压力站着，没有倒下。

normal.en: Not withstanding therefore means not giving way to, and the concession follows naturally.
normal.cn: not withstanding 因此意为「不向它退让」，让步义便自然跟出。

normal.en: The noun can come first: the delays notwithstanding, the bridge opened.
normal.cn: 名词可以放前面：尽管有延误，桥还是通车了。

normal.en: Statutes use notwithstanding to cancel a competing rule, not merely to admit a fact.
normal.cn: 法条用 notwithstanding 取消竞争性规则，而不只是承认事实。

normal.en: Despite is the everyday cousin; notwithstanding wears the formal coat.
normal.cn: despite 是日常表亲；notwithstanding 穿的是正式外套。

abstract.en: A dam holds even when the water is already halfway up its face.
abstract.cn: 堤坝即使水已漫到半腰，也仍然立着。

abstract.en: The word honours the thing that refuses to move, then lets the sentence move anyway.
abstract.cn: 这个词先致敬那个不肯让位的东西，然后让句子照样往前走。

abstract.en: Legal weight is a kind of weather that documents are built to stand in.
abstract.cn: 法律的分量是一种天气，而文件正是为站在这种天气里而造。

examples.en: Notwithstanding the cost, the repairs were approved.
examples.cn: 尽管成本高昂，修缮仍获批准。

examples.en: The committee proceeded notwithstanding that two members were absent.
examples.cn: 尽管两名成员缺席，委员会仍继续推进。

examples.en: The evidence was thin; the case went ahead notwithstanding.
examples.cn: 证据薄弱，案件却照旧进行。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「诺特维兹斯坦丁」，withstand 是「顶住」：not 加顶住，就是不被它挡住，即尽管

root: 古英语 withstandan「站着对抗」= with「对抗」+ standan「站立」→ 分词 withstanding → 否定短语 not withstanding「不向它退让」→ 十五世纪合为一词，义为「尽管」，可作介词、连词（notwithstanding that）与句末副词，也能后置在名词之后。属日耳曼语，无拉丁同族词，latinEntries 留空；法律拉丁语 non obstante 只是对应说法。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all keep one stance: something presses, and the main statement stands anyway. The word changes position and weight, from a preposition to a clause opener, a trailing adverb, a postposed phrase, and finally the heaviest legal override.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保持同一个姿态：有东西在施压，而主句照样站住。这个词改变的是位置与分量，从介词到从句引导词、句末副词、后置短语，最后到最重的法律排除用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dam already half overtopped, still holding the flood back.
core.cn: 核心意象：堤坝已被水漫过一半，却仍挡住洪水。

branches.en: NOT GIVING WAY: a noun phrase that does not block the result, and a person not limited by a factor.
branches.cn: 不退让：挡不住结果的名词短语，以及不受某因素限制的人。

branches.en: THE CLAUSE: notwithstanding that, the most formal way to concede a whole statement.
branches.cn: 从句：notwithstanding that，承认整句陈述最正式的方式。

branches.en: THE TRAILING WORD: standing alone at the end, repeating the concession.
branches.cn: 句末词：独自站在末尾，把让步再说一遍。

branches.en: THE POSTPOSED PHRASE: the participle following its noun, as absolute constructions do.
branches.cn: 后置短语：分词跟在名词之后，如绝对结构所为。

branches.en: THE OVERRIDE: cancelling a competing rule, giving priority to a later term, and the heaviest register.
branches.cn: 排除：取消竞争规则、使后订条款优先，以及最重的语体。

intro.en: Notwithstanding is a negative phrase built on the participle withstanding, which comes from withstand, itself with plus stand. No suffix is involved, so the items list components and parallel forms.
intro.cn: notwithstanding 是建在分词 withstanding 上的否定短语，而 withstanding 出自 withstand，即 with 加 stand。这里没有后缀，因此下面列出构词成分与平行形式。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic and has no Latin cognate, so no Latin entries are listed; non obstante expresses the same legal move in Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词属日耳曼语，没有拉丁同族词，因此不列拉丁词条；拉丁语 non obstante 表达同样的法律动作。

items.example: In withstand the first element means against, not together.
items.exampleCN: 在 withstand 里，第一个成分意为「对抗」，而不是「共同」。

items.example: Standing is the image the whole word keeps.
items.exampleCN: 「站着」是整个词保留的意象。

items.example: The verb names the act of not giving way.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词命名「不退让」的动作。

items.example: The participle supplies the second half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词提供复合词的后半截。

items.example: The negative turns resisting into not resisting.
items.exampleCN: 否定词把「抵挡」变成「不抵挡」。

items.structure: English compound phrase, fixed as one word
items.example: Legal records fix the single-word form in the fifteenth century.
items.exampleCN: 法律记录在十五世纪把它固定为单词形式。

items.example: The added that lets a full clause follow.
items.exampleCN: 加上 that 就能接完整从句。

items.example: Canadian constitutional law gives the device its name.
items.exampleCN: 加拿大宪法给了这一机制专名。

items.example: It is the shorter everyday alternative.
items.exampleCN: 它是更短的日常替代词。

items.example: It marks the clause that remains unaffected.
items.exampleCN: 它标记那个不受影响的主句。

definition_en: without regard to; used with of to say that a factor does not affect the matter
core_image: 一道闸门对所有来船一律放行，不看船上装的是什么
scene: 报名不看年龄也不看职业，只要交一份申请就行。Applications are accepted irrespective of age or occupation.
sceneCN: 这里指报名条件不以年龄或职业为转移（第 1 个义项：该短语后接名词，表示不论）；句意为申请获接受，不论年龄或职业。

pos.zh: 不论…的；不顾…的（几乎只用于「不论」这一固定结构）

derivatives.zh: 分别地（按顺序对应，与 irrespective 无关）

senses.title: Regardless of a stated factor
senses.definition: used with of to say that a named factor makes no difference
senses.definitionCN: 后接名词性成分，表示所述因素不起作用
senses.example: All students are admitted irrespective of background.
senses.exampleCN: 所有学生都被录取，不论其背景。
senses.why: The negative prefix in-, here ir-, cancels the regarding that respective implies, so the factor is explicitly put out of the account.
senses.whyCN: 否定前缀取消了 respective 所含的「顾及」，因此该因素被明确排除在考量之外。

senses.title: Independent of the method
senses.definition: used of a result that holds whatever method is chosen
senses.definitionCN: 指无论选哪种方法都成立的结果
senses.example: The result is valid irrespective of the method used.
senses.exampleCN: 无论采用何种方法，结果都有效。
senses.why: In research the phrase separates the finding from the procedure, which is exactly what the negative prefix does.
senses.whyCN: 在研究里，这个短语把结论与程序分开，而这正是否定前缀所做的事。

senses.title: Ignoring the cost
senses.definition: used when a consideration is deliberately set aside
senses.definitionCN: 指某一考量被有意搁置
senses.example: The rule applies irrespective of cost.
senses.exampleCN: 这条规则适用，不顾代价。
senses.why: Setting aside is stronger than ignoring by accident: the factor is named and then declared irrelevant.
senses.whyCN: 搁置比无意忽略更强：先点出那个因素，再宣布它无关。

senses.title: Independent of each other
senses.definition: used of two things that vary without affecting one another
senses.definitionCN: 指两事物各自变化而不互相影响
senses.example: The two variables change irrespective of each other.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个变量各自变化，与对方无关。
senses.why: Statistics needs a phrase for independence, and the word supplies it without the technical noun.
senses.whyCN: 统计需要一个表达独立性的短语，这个词不必用术语名词就能提供。

senses.title: Whatever the answer to whether
senses.definition: used in the frame irrespective of whether to cover both outcomes
senses.definitionCN: 用于后接「是否」从句的结构，涵盖两种结果
senses.example: The policy holds irrespective of whether prices rise.
senses.exampleCN: 无论物价是否上涨，这项政策都成立。
senses.why: The frame with whether names an open question and then declares both answers irrelevant.
senses.whyCN: 带「是否」的框架先点出一个未决问题，再宣布两种答案都无关紧要。

senses.title: Without distinction between people
senses.definition: used to say that a rule treats everyone the same
senses.definitionCN: 指某规则对所有人同等对待
senses.example: The law treats all applicants alike, irrespective of age.
senses.exampleCN: 法律对所有申请人同等对待，不论年龄。
senses.why: Non-discrimination is the social form of the same logic: a named difference is declared not to count.
senses.whyCN: 不歧视是同一逻辑的社会形态：被点名的差异被宣布不算数。

senses.title: Not recorded as a condition
senses.titleCN: 统计或法律上不予考虑
senses.definition: used in administrative writing for factors that are not counted
senses.definitionCN: 行政文字中指不予计入的因素
senses.example: Records are kept irrespective of nationality.
senses.exampleCN: 记录的保存不因国籍而区别对待。
senses.why: Administration must state which differences it ignores, and the phrase does that in three words.
senses.whyCN: 行政必须说明它忽略哪些差异，而这个短语用三个词就做到了。

senses.title: Ignoring what people say
senses.definition: used informally of acting without regard to other people's opinions
senses.definitionCN: 口语中指不顾他人看法而行动
senses.example: He went ahead irrespective of what people said.
senses.exampleCN: 他不顾别人怎么说，照样推进。
senses.why: The same structure extends from rules to opinions: the factor is named and dismissed in one gesture.
senses.whyCN: 同一结构从规则扩展到议论：一个动作里既点出因素又把它打发掉。

intro.en: Irrespective is ir-, the assimilated form of in- not, plus respective, from Latin respectivus, from respicere, to look back at, built from re- back and specere to look. The direct source is clear; the modern sense without regard to is recorded from the nineteenth century.
intro.cn: irrespective 是 ir-（in-「不」在 r 前的同化形式）加 respective；respective 出自拉丁语 respectivus，源自 respicere「回看」，由 re-「回」与 specere「看」构成。直接来源清楚；现代「不论」义记录于十九世纪。

items.en: Specere means to look, and it also gives species, spectrum, inspect and perspective.
items.cn: specere 意为看，也给出 species、spectrum、inspect 与 perspective。

items.en: Respicere is re- plus specere, to look back at or to have regard for something.
items.cn: respicere 是 re- 加 specere，意为回头看、顾及某物。

items.en: Respectivus means referring to or having regard to, and it passes into English as respective.
items.cn: respectivus 意为「有所参照、有所顾及」，进入英语作 respective。

items.en: Respective enters English in the fifteenth century, meaning relating to each one in turn, and respectively follows.
items.cn: respective 于十五世纪进入英语，意为「分别与各自相关的」，respectively 随后出现。

items.en: The negated irrespective appears in the nineteenth century with the sense without regard to, and the phrase irrespective of becomes standard.
items.cn: 否定形式 irrespective 于十九世纪出现，义为「不顾、不论」，短语 irrespective of 随之成为标准。

items.en: Modern English uses it mainly in formal writing on rules, statistics and rights, where a factor must be declared irrelevant.
items.cn: 现代英语主要在关于规则、统计与权利的正式文字中使用，用来宣布某一因素无关。

note.en: The first group shares the specere looking-root and contains the dangerous look-alike respectively, which orders items rather than ignoring factors. The second group gives plainer ways to say without regard to.
note.cn: 第一组共享 specere「看」词根，并包含危险的形近词 respectively，它给各项排序，而不是忽略因素。第二组给出「不论」的更朴素说法。

entries.definition: Relating separately to each of the items mentioned.
entries.definitionCN: 分别与所提到的各项相关。

entries.definition: In the order already given, item by item; it never means regardless.
entries.definitionCN: 按已给出的顺序逐项对应；它从不表示「不论」。

entries.definition: Regard or esteem; also a particular point or aspect, as in in this respect.
entries.definitionCN: 顾及或尊重；也指某一方面，如 in this respect。

entries.definition: Showing deference to someone.
entries.definitionCN: 对人表示敬重。

entries.definition: A rare adverb built on irrespective, mostly replaced by irrespective of.
entries.definitionCN: 建在 irrespective 上的罕用副词，多被 irrespective of 取代。

entries.definition: Without being affected by; the everyday equivalent.
entries.definitionCN: 不受…影响；日常对应说法。

entries.definition: Not depending on the stated factor.
entries.definitionCN: 不取决于所述因素。

entries.definition: The plain phrase behind the formal word.
entries.definitionCN: 这个正式词背后的朴素短语。

entries.definition: Whatever the case may be, in speech.
entries.definitionCN: 口语中表示「无论怎样」。

entries.definition: Whatever the circumstances, often closing an argument.
entries.definitionCN: 无论何种情况，常用于收束论证。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real respicere root, the ir- assimilation and the false friend respectively.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的 respicere 词根、ir- 同化规则，以及形近陷阱 respectively。

normal.en: Respicere is to look back at, so respect means having regard for; ir- cancels the regard.
normal.cn: respicere 是回头看，所以 respect 意为「有所顾及」；ir- 把这份顾及取消。

normal.en: Ir- is simply in- before an r, the same change seen in irregular and irreversible.
normal.cn: ir- 就是 r 前的 in-，同样的变化见于 irregular 与 irreversible。

normal.en: Respectively orders items; irrespective ignores factors. They look alike and mean different things.
normal.cn: respectively 给各项排序；irrespective 忽略因素。它们长得像，意思不同。

normal.en: The phrase is almost always irrespective of, so learn it as one block.
normal.cn: 这个说法几乎总是 irrespective of，把它整块记住。

normal.en: Statistics uses it for independence: two variables changing irrespective of each other.
normal.cn: 统计用它表达独立性：两个变量各自变化、互不相干。

abstract.en: A gate that opens for every boat has decided in advance not to look at the cargo.
abstract.cn: 对每艘船都放行的闸门，是事先决定不去看船上的货。

abstract.en: To say irrespective of is to name a difference and then refuse to weigh it.
abstract.cn: 说「不论」，就是先点名一种差异，再拒绝称它的重量。

abstract.en: Fairness is often just a list of the things that will not be counted.
abstract.cn: 公平往往只是一份清单，写明哪些东西不会被计入。

examples.en: The service is open to all residents, irrespective of income.
examples.cn: 这项服务面向所有居民，不论收入高低。

examples.en: The conclusion stands irrespective of which model is used.
examples.cn: 无论使用哪个模型，结论都成立。

examples.en: They continued the survey irrespective of the weather.
examples.cn: 他们不顾天气，继续做调查。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「伊瑞斯佩克提弗」，respect 是「顾及」，ir- 是否定：不顾及它，就是不论

root: 拉丁语 specere「看」→ respicere「回看、顾及」= re- + specere → respectivus「有所参照的」→ 英语 respective「各自的」；加否定前缀 in-（在 r 前同化为 ir-）得 irrespective「不顾、不论」，现代义记录于十九世纪。直接来源清楚。注意 respectively 是「分别地」，与 irrespective 无关。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all declare one factor irrelevant: background, method, cost, a companion variable, an open whether, a personal difference, a recorded condition, and other people's opinions.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在宣布某一因素无关：背景、方法、代价、另一个变量、未决的「是否」、人与人的差异、被记录的条件，以及他人的议论。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gate that lets every boat through without looking at the cargo.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道闸门对所有来船一律放行，不看船上装的是什么。

branches.en: THE CANCELLED REGARD: a named factor that makes no difference, and a result valid whatever method is used.
branches.cn: 被取消的顾及：点名的因素不起作用，以及无论用什么方法都有效的结论。

branches.en: THE COST SET ASIDE: a consideration deliberately put out of the account.
branches.cn: 搁置的代价：被有意排除在考量之外的考虑。

branches.en: THE INDEPENDENCE: two variables that vary without affecting each other.
branches.cn: 独立性：两个变量各自变化而不互相影响。

branches.en: THE OPEN CONDITION: both answers to whether, and a factor not recorded as a condition.
branches.cn: 未定的条件：whether 的两种答案，以及未被记为条件的因素。

branches.en: EQUAL TREATMENT: one rule for everyone, and acting without regard to what people say.
branches.cn: 同等对待：一条规则对所有人，以及不顾他人议论而行动。

intro.en: Irrespective is ir-, the assimilated negative in-, plus respective, from respicere, to look back at. The prefix removes the regard that respect implies.
intro.cn: irrespective 是 ir-（否定前缀 in- 的同化形式）加 respective，而 respective 出自 respicere「回看」。前缀把 respect 所含的「顾及」拿掉。

latinIntro.en: Specere, to look, and respicere, to look back at, supply the regard; negating that regard yields the modern sense without regard to.
latinIntro.cn: specere「看」与 respicere「回看」提供那份「顾及」；把这份顾及否定掉，就得到现代义「不论」。

items.example: The root also gives inspect, spectacle and perspective.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也给出 inspect、spectacle 与 perspective。

items.example: It turns looking into looking back at something.
items.exampleCN: 它把「看」变成「回头看某物」。

items.meaning: to look back at; to have regard for
items.example: The verb supplies the regard that the negative cancels.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供被否定词取消的那份顾及。

items.example: English respect comes through this noun.
items.exampleCN: 英语 respect 经这个名词而来。

items.example: The adjective becomes English respective.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词成为英语 respective。

items.example: The adjective distributes items one by one.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词把各项逐一分配。

items.example: It is a false friend, not a synonym of irrespective.
items.exampleCN: 它是形近陷阱，不是 irrespective 的同义词。

items.example: Before r it assimilates to ir-, as in irregular.
items.exampleCN: 在 r 前同化为 ir-，如 irregular。

items.example: The prefix cancels the regard and produces the modern sense.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀取消顾及，产生现代义。

items.example: The word is almost always followed by of.
items.exampleCN: 这个词后面几乎总跟着 of。
